New alert: order-worker degraded Monday morning. Service: order-worker, severity: SEV2.
Symptoms: Job throughput on order-worker has dropped sharply since about 07:00 this morning; the processing backlog is growing and the cache layer is reporting it is out of memory.
Error: cache layer out of memory, order-worker service health degraded

Evidence (only these incidents may be cited):
Incident INC-003 (order-worker, SEV2, 2026-05-18T07:05:41Z):
Symptoms: order-worker job processing stalled Monday morning; Redis returning OOM errors, queue depth past 41k, order confirmation emails delayed.
Root cause: Weekend order volume queued jobs and cached idempotency keys in Redis without eviction; by Monday's traffic ramp Redis hit its 2GB maxmemory limit with the default noeviction policy.
Resolver: Ananya Iyer

Incident INC-008 (order-worker, SEV2, 2026-06-15T06:58:12Z):
Symptoms: Second Monday-morning Redis OOM in a month; order-worker queue depth past 38k again, same signature as INC-003.
Root cause: The allkeys-lru eviction policy set after INC-003 slowed the OOM but idempotency keys from the order-retry-queue still have no TTL, so memory pressure builds back up over the weekend.
Resolver: Ananya Iyer

Incident INC-016 (order-worker, SEV1, 2026-07-21T17:03:26Z):
Symptoms: order-worker pods repeatedly OOMKilled every 20-30 minutes since a deploy 2 hours ago; job processing throughput down 60%.
Root cause: A newly upgraded image-resize library (v4.2.0) leaks native memory buffers on each thumbnail generation call, growing pod RSS until the kubelet OOM-kills the container.
Resolver: David Kim

Ranked fixes (use the top one as first_actions[0]):
  1. restart_redis_and_set_eviction_policy (score=+0.282, worked=1, partial=0, failed=0, recent_failures=0)
  2. manual_flush_stale_keys (score=+0.212, worked=0, partial=2, failed=0, recent_failures=0)
  3. add_ttl_to_job_result_keys (score=+0.143, worked=1, partial=0, failed=0, recent_failures=0)
  4. fix_ttl_key_prefix_mismatch (score=+0.000, worked=1, partial=0, failed=0, recent_failures=0)
Recurrence: This is occurrence #4 of this pattern, recurring roughly every 28 days.
Team expert: Ananya Iyer (Resolved 3 incidents matching this pattern with a working fix.)
